notes: Chunk 83: 6 pages, 7 snapshots, all Common Crawl captures (sourceUrl = index lookup address). Colorado Boulder (116 people): page lists 'PhD: <year>' and 'Placement:'; listedYear is the PhD year (yearMeaning graduation), destination the placement as written; 'Initial Placement'/'Current Placement' pairs are kept with the initial as destination and the current in note; 12 people appear under two program sections and were merged into one record each with both sections in program. Two placements read 'No information provided'/'N/A' and were set to null. UConn: single alumni profile (Brian Fox '17 Ph.D.), class-of 2017, accepted Assistant Professor at Bentley University. Illinois ISE (88 rows): 'Recent Ph.D. Dissertations' table; the term column (e.g. 'Summer 2019') is unlabeled, so yearMeaning is unstated (it is the dissertation term); names are kept in the page's 'Last, First' form; advisor and IDEALS handle in note; an irregular 'Rosaline Kone / 2014-05' row duplicates the 'Kone, Roseline Estelle Sindolmane / Spring 2014' row. Iowa Tippie Business Analytics: one job-market candidate (Michael Redmond), no year on page, listedYear null. UNIL past PhD theses (81 rows): names in 'SURNAME First' form as written; year headings 2006-2019 on a 'Past PhD theses' page (yearMeaning unstated: thesis year); committee/supervisor lines kept in note when the page gives them; a stray unyeared 'Ashley Bin Ding' line at the top of the page is recorded separately from 'DING Ashley Bin' (2018). UNIL Placements & Alumni (2 snapshots, 14 rows): the page has no placement list, only seven alumni testimonials with current titles, recorded with null year; Nicolas Bastardoz's affiliation changed between the 2019 and 2020 captures. No unreadable snapshots.
